Visa4Bali processes E-VOA applications in 1 to 2 working days for Rp750,000, a fee that already includes both the e-VOA and the government e-VOA charge. To apply you need three things: a passport with at least 6 months' validity remaining, a clear photo of the passport holder, and your onward flight ticket. Because approval happens before departure, E-VOA is the fastest way to secure a 30-day Bali tourist visa without queuing.

products.name: VISA ON ARRIVAL EXTENSION
products.description:
Visa on Arrival allows you to have 1 time extension for another 30 days.

You should have the electonic stay permit for extension.

Extension will be in electonic stay permit, once the process done we will send the soft file to you, you can scan the barcode and it will direct you to immigration system, it will show your stay permit details.

* Note please:
Days off – Saturdays and Sundays, Public Holidays , are not calculating as visa processing days.

If system in immigration office is under maintenance and error, this days are not calculating as visa processing days.

Its important to apply extension application before visa expired, process of extension can be finished after. You will not get fined.
If extension already in process of regular extension, speeding up will cost 250 000 idr.
In case of cancelation of extension full price will be charged
Couriers can pick up / delivery your passport from 10.00am till 4.00pm, from Monday till Friday. It should be arranged 1 day before.
Couriers need time slot of 2 hours, in case of traffic jams, someone was late for previous meeting etc.

products.name: TOURIST VISA 211 Extension
products.description:
The Tourist Visa 211/C1 lets you stay in Indonesia for up to 180 days without leaving the country, and Visa4Bali handles the full extension process for Rp1,800,000.

The visa gives an initial 60-day stay, which can then be extended twice, 60 days at a time, to reach the 180-day maximum. Each extension is issued as an electronic stay permit with a soft-copy file and a barcode registered in the immigration system, so there is no physical sticker to collect. Weekends and Indonesian public holidays are not counted as processing days, so apply before your current permit expires; the extension can still be completed shortly after. To start, Visa4Bali needs only your passport, and the team prepares every required application document and arranges a local sponsor on your behalf.
